label: D2 after repeating a2 into S2 (common) following an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 via the common transition (in_action=2 and in_state=2 hold for >99.9% of activations). Within that, it needs the previous trial to have been unrewarded (prev_reward=0 holds 98% of mass; it almost never fires when the D1 reward input was 1). It also needs the choice not to be a switch (stay=0 gives ~0 activations). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1 or S1, or on rare transitions. All variables are observed by D2. Dev scores: P=0.71, R=0.90, F1=0.79, mass recall 0.98. The remaining false positives are concentrated late in the episode: the feature is nearly silent in trials 90-99, peaks in trials 60-79, and adding ep_trial<88 raises dev F1 to 0.83. Weaker activations sit on the margins of the predicate, and the top activations are covered fully. Higher activations line up with moderately negative GO policy logits (choice in [-4.4,-1.5]) and high value, but I did not turn these into a magnitude rule. Requiring prev_common=0 hurts badly, so the feature does not track whether the previous trial was rare.
